name: How long does it take to install custom baseboards in a typical home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install custom baseboards in a typical home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for installing custom baseboards varies based on the total linear footage, the complexity of the design, and the number of rooms involved. For an average-sized home, the installation could range from a few days to over a week. Factors like preparing walls, intricate cuts, and custom finishing work can extend the project duration. Maine Results, Inc. provides a clear timeline estimate after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by linear footage, design complexity, and rooms, typically ranging from a few days to over a week for an average home.
